15import logging 

16 

17import torch 

18import triton 

19import triton.language as tl 

20 

21from flag_gems.utils import libentry 

22 

23logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

24 

25 

26@libentry() 

27@triton.jit 

28def _adaptive_avg_pool1d_kernel( 

29 X, 

30 Y, 

31 L_IN, 

32 L_OUT, 

33 BLOCKS_PER_PLANE, 

34 MAX_WINDOW: tl.constexpr, 

35 BLOCK_OUT: tl.constexpr, 

36): 

37 # One program handles BLOCK_OUT output positions of a single (N, C) plane. 

38 # aten's bin edges are floor(i*L_IN/L_OUT) and ceil((i+1)*L_IN/L_OUT); 

39 # loading a MAX_WINDOW-wide 2D tile lets all bins reduce in one tl.sum. 

40 # GCU400 caps grid.y at 255, while N*C can be far larger. Encode both the 

41 # output-block index and the plane index into a single grid.x dimension. 

42 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

43 out_block = pid % BLOCKS_PER_PLANE 

44 plane = pid // BLOCKS_PER_PLANE 

45 out_pos = out_block * BLOCK_OUT + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_OUT) 

46 

47 bin_start = (out_pos * L_IN) // L_OUT 

48 bin_end = ((out_pos + 1) * L_IN + L_OUT - 1) // L_OUT 

49 window = tl.arange(0, MAX_WINDOW) 

50 in_pos = bin_start[:, None] + window[None, :] 

51 valid = (out_pos[:, None] < L_OUT) & (in_pos < bin_end[:, None]) & (in_pos < L_IN) 

52 values = tl.load(X + plane * L_IN + in_pos, mask=valid, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) 

53 count = tl.maximum(bin_end - bin_start, 1) 

54 mean = tl.sum(values, 1) / count.to(tl.float32) 

55 tl.store( 

56 Y + plane * L_OUT + out_pos, mean.to(Y.dtype.element_ty), mask=out_pos < L_OUT 

57 ) 

58 

59 

60def adaptive_avg_pool1d(input: torch.Tensor, output_size): 

61 """Adaptive average pooling over 1D input. 

62 

63 The shared ``adaptive_avg_pool2d`` path lowers through 

64 ``_adaptive_pool_windows``, whose pointer-array tile makes the GCU400 

65 PassManager fail for every dtype. Calling ``aten::adaptive_avg_pool1d`` 

66 directly is not an option either: FlagGems registers that very overload, so 

67 it recurses back here. This backend-specific kernel computes the bins 

68 directly from the 1D layout instead. 

69 """ 

70 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME ADAPTIVE_AVG_POOL1D") 

71 

72 assert input.ndim == 3, f"adaptive_avg_pool1d expects 3D input, got {input.ndim}D" 

73 if isinstance(output_size, (list, tuple)): 

74 output_size = output_size[0] 

75 

76 num_planes, _, length_in = input.shape 

77 length_out = output_size 

78 out = torch.empty( 

79 (input.shape[0], input.shape[1], length_out), 

80 dtype=input.dtype, 

81 device=input.device, 

82 ) 

83 if length_out == 0: 

84 return out 

85 

86 max_window = triton.next_power_of_2(triton.cdiv(length_in, length_out) + 1) 

87 block_out = min(64, triton.next_power_of_2(length_out)) 

88 blocks_per_plane = triton.cdiv(length_out, block_out) 

89 grid = (blocks_per_plane * num_planes * input.shape[1],) 

90 _adaptive_avg_pool1d_kernel[grid]( 

91 input, 

92 out, 

93 length_in, 

94 length_out, 

95 blocks_per_plane, 

96 max_window, 

97 block_out, 

98 num_warps=8, 

99 ) 

100 return out
